title: AgentPhishing: A Benchmark of LLM Email Agents Under Adaptive Attack
title_zh: AgentPhishing：自适应攻击下LLM邮件智能体的基准

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents increasingly handle private information and act on users’ behalf across desktop and web applications, including email. Phishing therefore poses privacy and security risks that depend not only on whether agents recognize malicious messages, but also on how they respond. Existing phishing datasets were developed primarily for conventional detection, leaving agent susceptibility to persuasive malicious requests insufficiently characterized. To expose vulnerabilities that pre-existing datasets may miss, we introduce AgentPhishing , a benchmark for evaluating whether persuasive phishing attacks can evade detection and induce LLM email agents to comply with malicious requests. We develop PhishOpt , which optimizes reusable email-generation skills against individual agents under fixed benchmark constraints and a realism constraint. We analyze the generated emails using Cialdini’s persuasion principles to identify strategies associated with agent failures and use these findings to construct a universal generation skill. Our evaluation shows that agents can handle pre-existing phishing emails safely yet remain susceptible to attacks adapted to agent behavior, while in an AgentPhishing evaluation of nine agents, four exhibit phishing-detection rates below 10 % 10\% and malicious-request compliance rates above 45 % 45\% . These results highlight the limits of inferring agent safety from conventional phishing evaluations and the need to assess how agents respond to persuasive malicious requests.

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents powered by large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) offer a way to delegate everyday tasks across desktop and web applications ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2024 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Kimi Team, 2026 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Drouin et al., 2024 ) . To carry out these tasks, agents interpret external content while accessing private information and taking actions on users’ behalf. Adversaries who influence this content may redirect those actions, creating privacy and security risks ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ) . Agents managing email provide a concrete setting for studying these risks: unlike conventional phishing detectors that classify messages, they may also carry out requests within them, including requests to disclose sensitive information or perform other unauthorized actions ( Wu et al., 2026 ; 1Password, 2026 ) . Assessing their trustworthiness in this setting requires examining both whether they detect phishing and whether they comply with malicious requests, rather than inferring safe behavior from detection performance alone ( Levy et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 由大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs）驱动的计算机使用智能体提供了一种在桌面和网络应用中委派日常任务的方式（OpenAI, 2025; Anthropic, 2024; Google DeepMind, 2025; Zhou et al., 2026; Kimi Team, 2026; Xie et al., 2024; Drouin et al., 2024）。 为了执行这些任务，智能体在访问私密信息并代表用户采取行动的同时，还需要解读外部内容。 能够影响这些内容的攻击者可能会使这些行动偏离方向，从而造成隐私和安全风险（Debenedetti et al., 2024; Zhan et al., 2024）。 管理电子邮件的智能体为研究这些风险提供了一个具体的场景：与仅对邮件进行分类的传统钓鱼检测器不同，它们还可能执行邮件中的请求，包括泄露敏感信息或执行其他未经授权操作的请求（Wu et al., 2026; 1Password, 2026）。 在这种场景下评估智能体的可信赖性，需要同时考察它们能否检测出钓鱼邮件以及是否会遵从恶意请求，而不能仅凭检测性能来推断其行为是否安全（Levy et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Prior work shows that deceptive messages can evade phishing detectors, influence LLM judgments, and induce unsafe actions by agents carrying out user tasks ( Qi et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2026 ; 1Password, 2026 ) . Existing phishing email datasets provide reference material for evaluating detection performance ( Puyang, 2025 ; Ganiuly & Smaiyl, 2025 ) , but as agents and their defenses evolve, continued risk assessment also requires methods that can generate and refine attacks against updated systems. Phishing research provides foundations for such methods through reusable generators with realism validation and persuasion analysis ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and iterative email refinement using detector feedback ( Qi et al., 2025 ) . However, realism and detection evasion do not measure whether an agent carries out a malicious request, motivating evaluation that accounts for behavior. Feedback-driven red-teaming addresses this need by learning reusable attack strategies and optimizing attacks through target responses and execution outcomes ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Syros et al., 2026 ) . Yet success under prompt-injection attacks does not establish how effective social-engineering attacks remain when explicit instruction overrides and fabricated system directives are excluded. AgentBait directly evaluates social-engineering attacks that use deception and persuasion to induce unsafe actions by task-performing agents, including through email-based inducements ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Its reported attack construction, however, follows predefined strategies rather than iteratively improving generation from the evaluated agent’s responses. These complementary advances motivate a more specific investigation: how do agents’ phishing detection and compliance with malicious requests change when the generation of social-engineering emails is optimized against their behavior under these attack-content constraints?

paragraphs.en: To address this question, we introduce AgentPhishing, a benchmark for evaluating agents’ phishing detection and compliance with malicious requests under social-engineering attacks in email tasks. We construct its adaptive attacks using PhishOpt, which optimizes target-specific generation skills and uses persuasion analysis to derive a universal skill. Its optimization procedure builds on SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) to refine email-generation skills from target-agent feedback under fixed generation requirements and a realism constraint. We analyze emails generated by the agent-specific skills using Cialdini’s persuasion principles ( Cialdini, 1984 ) , both to characterize framings associated with detection and compliance outcomes and to guide the construction of a universal generation skill. Our experiments compare pre-existing phishing emails, unoptimized synthetic emails, and skill-generated attacks under a common evaluation protocol to assess how attack generation affects observed safety performance. We also evaluate agent-specific and universal skills across agents to examine their cross-agent effectiveness.

paragraphs.en: Phishing Detection and Susceptibility. Phishing research examines whether deceptive content can be identified and whether recipients act on it. Conventional studies develop email classifiers, investigate judgments of fraudulent websites, and characterize real-world SMS phishing campaigns ( Fette et al., 2007 ; Dhamija et al., 2006 ; Nahapetyan et al., 2024 ) . Complementary human-centered research examines how social relationships and contextual cues influence susceptibility across email, social media, and text messaging ( Jagatic et al., 2007 ; Vishwanath, 2017 ; Tabassum et al., 2024 ; Zhuo et al., 2023 ) . These studies assess behavior such as information disclosure, extending phishing evaluation beyond classification ( Jagatic et al., 2007 ; Vishwanath, 2017 ) .

paragraphs.en: Feedback-Driven Attack Generation. Phishing-generation methods can use feedback to improve realism or detection evasion. PEEK trains a reusable generator with real-vs-synthetic discrimination and incorporates extracted persuasion patterns ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . SpearBot revises emails using detector critiques ( Qi et al., 2025 ) . Behavioral red-teaming instead uses target responses or actions to guide attack improvement. AutoDAN-Turbo retains successful jailbreak strategies in a textual library for subsequent generation ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . RL-Hammer learns a reusable generator by updating attacker-model parameters through reinforcement learning ( Wen et al., 2025 ) . At the payload level, AutoInject optimizes injection suffixes using target feedback, while MUZZLE refines injection locations and payloads using execution trajectories and failure feedback, including in credential-phishing scenarios ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Syros et al., 2026 ) . PhishOpt adapts SkillOpt to phishing generation, using target-agent detection and compliance as feedback ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Whereas AgentBait constructs attacks from predefined social-engineering categories, PhishOpt iteratively refines target-specific generation skills using agent feedback ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于反馈的攻击生成。 钓鱼生成方法可以利用反馈来提升真实性或规避检测。 PEEK 通过真实与合成样本判别来训练一个可复用的生成器，并融入提取出的说服模式（Chen et al., 2024）。 SpearBot 依据检测器的批评意见修改邮件（Qi et al., 2025）。 行为红队测试则使用目标模型的回复或动作来指导攻击的改进。 AutoDAN-Turbo 将成功的越狱策略保留在文本库中，用于后续生成（Liu et al., 2025）。 RL-Hammer 通过强化学习更新攻击者模型参数，从而学习一个可复用的生成器（Wen et al., 2025）。 在载荷层面，AutoInject 利用目标模型的反馈优化注入后缀，而 MUZZLE 则利用执行轨迹和失败反馈来改进注入位置与载荷，包括在凭证钓鱼场景中（Chen et al., 2026；Syros et al., 2026）。 PhishOpt 将 SkillOpt 适配到钓鱼生成中，以目标智能体的检测情况和合规情况作为反馈（Yang et al., 2026）。 AgentBait 从预定义的社会工程类别构造攻击，而 PhishOpt 则利用智能体反馈迭代改进针对特定目标的生成技能（Wu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Persuasion in Social-Engineering Attacks. Persuasion analysis relates deceptive-request features to recipient responses. Cialdini’s principles describe mechanisms of influence ( Cialdini, 1984 ) , and phishing studies apply them to characterize message content and investigate susceptibility or detection ( Lawall, 2025 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . PsyScam annotates psychological techniques in real-world scams, while SCRIPTMIND examines scam structure through crime-script inference and cognitive evaluation ( Ma et al., 2025a ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . These analyses can support generation as well as detection: PEEK feeds extracted persuasion patterns into subsequent emails, and AgentBait evaluates social-engineering categories and controlled wording variations against agents ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . AgentPhishing uses persuasion principles to guide PhishOpt’s universal skill construction and characterize agents’ detection and compliance patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 社会工程攻击中的说服。 说服分析将欺骗性请求特征与接收者反应相关联。 西奥迪尼的原则描述了影响机制（Cialdini, 1984），钓鱼研究将其应用于刻画消息内容并研究易感性或检测能力（Lawall, 2025; Pan et al., 2026）。 PsyScam 标注真实诈骗中的心理技术，而 SCRIPTMIND 通过犯罪脚本推理和认知评估来考察诈骗结构（Ma et al., 2025a; Kim et al., 2026）。 这些分析既能支持生成也能支持检测：PEEK 将提取的说服模式注入后续邮件，而 AgentBait 针对智能体评估社会工程类别和受控措辞变化（Chen et al., 2024; Wu et al., 2026）。 AgentPhishing 利用说服原则指导 PhishOpt 的通用技能构建，并刻画智能体的检测与遵从模式。

paragraphs.en: To study agents’ phishing detection and compliance with malicious requests in email tasks, we synthesize evaluation emails using PhishOpt, which develops reusable, target-specific skills and an analysis-informed universal skill. Each skill specifies natural-language email-generation instructions. PhishOpt comprises two stages: target-specific skill optimization and analysis-informed universal skill construction. The first (Section 3.2 , 3.3 ) evolves a shared base skill into target-specific skill using agent feedback. Built on SkillOpt’s bounded-edit procedure ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , it adds a phishing-specific objective and generation constraints (Section 3.3 ). The second analyzes emails generated by the evolved skills using Cialdini’s persuasion principles to relate framing to detection and compliance outcomes and construct a universal skill without further optimization (Section 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究智能体在电子邮件任务中对钓鱼邮件的检测能力以及对恶意请求的遵从情况，我们使用 PhishOpt 合成评测邮件，该方法能够开发可复用、针对特定目标的技能，以及一种基于分析的通用技能。 每个技能都以自然语言形式给出电子邮件生成指令。 PhishOpt 包含两个阶段：针对特定目标的技能优化和基于分析的通用技能构建。 第一阶段（第 3.2、3.3 节）利用智能体反馈，将一个共享的基础技能演化为针对特定目标的技能。 该阶段以 SkillOpt 的有界编辑流程（Yang et al., 2026）为基础，增加了钓鱼攻击专用的优化目标和生成约束（第 3.3 节）。 第二阶段利用 Cialdini 的说服原理分析演化技能所生成的电子邮件，将表述方式与检测结果和遵从结果相关联，并据此构建一个无需进一步优化的通用技能（第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Candidate proposal. For each target agent, the shared base skill is evaluated to initialize the best skill found so far and its recorded metrics. At each iteration, the optimizer receives this skill and its detection, compliance, and classification metrics, then proposes a candidate through one bounded edit. Edits must preserve a locked rules block specifying fictional entities, placeholder secrets, benign controls, JSON output, and an approximately balanced benign–phishing label split; candidate skills that alter it are rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 候选技能提案。 对于每个目标智能体，先评估共享的基础技能，用以初始化目前找到的最佳技能及其记录的指标。 在每次迭代中，优化器接收该技能及其检测、合规与分类指标，然后通过一次有界编辑提出一个候选技能。 编辑必须保留一个锁定的规则块，其中规定了虚构实体、占位符密钥、良性对照、JSON 输出以及大致均衡的良性–钓鱼标签划分；改动该规则块的候选技能将被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Constraint checking and objective evaluation. The generator produces a probe batch from the candidate skill. The realism judge assesses this batch to determine whether the skill satisfies the realism constraint. If the skill passes, the generator produces a separate, fresh evaluation batch containing phishing emails and benign controls. The target agent processes this batch and selects actions and, where applicable, drafts replies. The evaluator computes detection, compliance, and classification metrics from these outputs to obtain the objective value defined in Section 3.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 约束检查与客观评估。 生成器从候选技能中产出一个探测批次。 真实性评判器评估该批次，以判断该技能是否满足真实性约束。 如果该技能通过，生成器会另行产出一个全新的评估批次，其中包含钓鱼邮件和良性对照样本。 目标智能体处理该批次，选择动作，并在适用情况下起草回复。 评估器根据这些输出计算检测、合规与分类指标，从而得到第 3.3 节中定义的目标值。

paragraphs.en: Realism constraint. The intended attack space consists of social-engineering content, excluding explicit instruction overrides and fabricated system directives. The realism judge scores a probe batch on plausibility, coherence, naturalness, and the absence of unrealistic exploitation artifacts, each on a [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale. A candidate passes if the mean score across all four criteria and sampled emails is at least τ \tau ; otherwise, it is rejected before target-agent evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 现实性约束。 预期的攻击空间由社会工程学内容构成，不包括显式指令覆盖和伪造的系统指令。 现实性评判器按可信度、连贯性、自然度以及不存在不切实际的攻击痕迹这几个维度对探针批次进行打分，每个维度都采用 [0,1] 的评分尺度。 若候选探针在四项标准及抽样邮件上的平均得分不低于 τ，则通过；否则，它会在目标智能体评估之前被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation protocol. The target-agent role in Table 1 appears in both PhishOpt and AgentPhishing. The PhishOpt target agent provides the feedback used to evolve a target-specific skill, whereas the AgentPhishing target agent processes evaluation emails generated using that skill. Target-specific evaluation uses the same model in both roles. Cross-agent evaluation varies these identities: diagonal conditions use the same model as the PhishOpt and AgentPhishing target agent, whereas off-diagonal conditions evaluate a skill optimized against one model on another. The fixed generator remains separate from both target-agent roles. The universal skill has no PhishOpt target agent and is evaluated directly across AgentPhishing target agents with the skill and generator model held fixed. The experimental setup specifies model versions, sample sizes, repetitions, and whether agents receive the same email batches. Post-generation diversity and repetition diagnostics include Self-BLEU ( Zhu et al., 2018 ) , Distinct-1/2 ( Li et al., 2016 ) , gzip compression ratio, and repeated 4-gram rate.
paragraphs.zh: 评估协议。 表 1 中的目标智能体角色在 PhishOpt 和 AgentPhishing 中均出现。 PhishOpt 目标智能体提供用于演化目标特定技能的反馈，而 AgentPhishing 目标智能体处理使用该技能生成的评估邮件。 目标特定评估在两种角色中使用相同的模型。 跨智能体评估改变这些身份：对角线条件使用与 PhishOpt 和 AgentPhishing 目标智能体相同的模型，而非对角线条件则在另一个模型上评估针对某一模型优化的技能。 固定生成器与两个目标智能体角色保持分离。 通用技能没有 PhishOpt 目标智能体，而是在保持技能和生成器模型固定的情况下，直接跨 AgentPhishing 目标智能体进行评估。 实验设置规定了模型版本、样本量、重复次数，以及各智能体是否接收相同的邮件批次。 生成后的多样性与重复性诊断指标包括 Self-BLEU（Zhu 等，2018）、Distinct-1/2（Li 等，2016）、gzip 压缩比和重复 4 元组比例。

paragraphs.en: Experiment setup. We evaluate six target agents, namely Qwen3.7-Plus, Kimi-K2.5, Grok-4.20, GPT-5.4, Claude-Sonnet-5, and Gemini-3.5-Flash, on pre-existing emails sampled from the Seven Phishing Email Datasets collection, spanning TREC-05, TREC-06, TREC-07, CEAS-08, Enron, Ling-Spam, and SpamAssassin-derived sources ( Puyang, 2025 ) , as well as synthetic emails generated using the base skill as the unoptimized synthetic baseline, and emails generated using the corresponding target-specific evolved skill against each target. We measure phishing detection ( ↑ \uparrow ), malicious-request compliance ( ↓ \downarrow ), and F 1 F_{1} ( ↑ \uparrow ), and combine them into the Susceptibility score ( ↓ \downarrow ) defined in Section 3.3 .

paragraphs.en: Results. Figure 3 A compares PhishOpt objective scores across public-corpus emails, base-skill emails, and target-specific evolved-skill emails. All six agents detect every phishing email from the public corpora and comply with none of their malicious requests ( Puyang, 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: Experimental setup. To address Q3 , we analyze 180 phishing-email evaluations from the six target-specific evolved-skill corpora. The analysis includes all phishing emails, covering both successful and unsuccessful attacks rather than conditioning on agent failures. We annotate the emails for six persuasion principles: Reciprocity, Commitment and Consistency, Social Proof, Authority, Liking, and Scarcity/Urgency. We compute ϕ \phi coefficients relating each principle’s presence to detection failure ( ↓ \downarrow ) and malicious-request compliance ( ↓ \downarrow ). Positive coefficients indicate an association with the corresponding unsafe outcome, whereas negative coefficients indicate an association with its absence. We then provide the annotations, agent outcomes, and generation constraints to Opus 4.8 to synthesize a universal skill without additional target-specific optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 实验设置。 为了回答 Q3，我们分析了来自六个针对特定目标的演化技能语料库的 180 次钓鱼邮件评估。 该分析涵盖所有钓鱼邮件，既包括成功的攻击也包括不成功的攻击，而不是仅以智能体失败为条件。 我们对邮件标注了六种说服原则：互惠、承诺与一致性、社会认同、权威、好感以及稀缺性/紧迫性。 我们计算 ϕ \phi 系数，将每种原则的存在与否与检测失败（ ↓ \downarrow ）和恶意请求依从（ ↓ \downarrow ）相关联。 正系数表示与相应的不安全结果存在关联，而负系数表示与该结果的缺失存在关联。 随后，我们将标注、智能体结果和生成约束提供给 Opus 4.8，以在无需额外针对特定目标优化的情况下综合出一个通用技能。

sents.zh: 该分析涵盖所有钓鱼邮件，既包括成功的攻击也包括不成功的攻击，而不是仅以智能体失败为条件。

sents.en: We annotate the emails for six persuasion principles: Reciprocity, Commitment and Consistency, Social Proof, Authority, Liking, and Scarcity/Urgency.
sents.zh: 我们对邮件标注了六种说服原则：互惠、承诺与一致性、社会认同、权威、好感以及稀缺性/紧迫性。

sents.en: We compute ϕ \phi coefficients relating each principle’s presence to detection failure ( ↓ \downarrow ) and malicious-request compliance ( ↓ \downarrow ).
sents.zh: 我们计算 ϕ \phi 系数，将每种原则的存在与否与检测失败（ ↓ \downarrow ）和恶意请求依从（ ↓ \downarrow ）相关联。

sents.en: Positive coefficients indicate an association with the corresponding unsafe outcome, whereas negative coefficients indicate an association with its absence.
sents.zh: 正系数表示与相应的不安全结果存在关联，而负系数表示与该结果的缺失存在关联。

sents.en: We then provide the annotations, agent outcomes, and generation constraints to Opus 4.8 to synthesize a universal skill without additional target-specific optimization.
sents.zh: 随后，我们将标注、智能体结果和生成约束提供给 Opus 4.8，以在无需额外针对特定目标优化的情况下综合出一个通用技能。

paragraphs.en: Persuasion-principle analysis. Across the 180 evaluations, we observe 51 detection failures and 21 compliance cases. Figure 5 shows that Commitment and Consistency is positively associated with both detection failure ( ϕ = 0.2407 \phi=0.2407 ) and compliance ( ϕ = 0.1391 \phi=0.1391 ). This principle captures requests framed as continuing an existing task or honoring a prior commitment, suggesting that apparent consistency with an ongoing workflow can accompany unsafe agent responses. Liking, which captures friendly or relationship-building framing, is positively associated with detection failure ( ϕ = 0.1914 \phi=0.1914 ) but has almost no association with compliance ( ϕ = 0.0018 \phi=0.0018 ). This difference illustrates that persuasion features associated with missed detection need not also be associated with malicious-request compliance. In contrast, Authority and Scarcity/Urgency are negatively associated with detection failure ( ϕ = − 0.1502 \phi=-0.1502 and − 0.1976 -0.1976 , respectively), and Scarcity/Urgency is also negatively associated with compliance ( ϕ = − 0.1460 \phi=-0.1460 ). Together, these observations suggest that overt authority and urgency cues may be easier for agents to recognize than workflow-continuation framing. These are associations within the evaluated corpora, not evidence that individual principles independently cause the observed outcomes.

paragraphs.en: Universal skill results. In Figure 4 B, emails generated using the universal skill yield detection rates below 10 % 10\% and compliance rates above 45 % 45\% for four of the nine additional target agents. These results show that the analysis-informed skill generates effective attacks against multiple agents without further target-specific optimization. paragraphs.en: We introduced AgentPhishing to evaluate phishing detection and malicious-request compliance by LLM email agents, and PhishOpt to optimize reusable target-specific generation skills and construct an analysis-informed universal skill. Our experiments show that safe handling of pre-existing phishing emails can coexist with failures under adaptive persuasive attacks. Cross-agent and held-out evaluations reveal substantial differences in susceptibility across evaluated agents, while detection failure and compliance remain distinct outcomes. Cialdini-principle analysis informs a universal skill that exposes vulnerabilities across multiple held-out agents without further target-specific optimization, although it does not establish consistent superiority over evolved skills. Together, these findings motivate adaptive, behavior-based evaluation alongside conventional phishing tests.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 AgentPhishing 来评估大语言模型邮件智能体的钓鱼检测能力与对恶意请求的服从性，并提出 PhishOpt 来优化可复用的针对特定目标的生成技能，并构建一个由分析驱动的通用技能。 我们的实验表明，对既有钓鱼邮件的安全处理可以与自适应说服性攻击下的失败并存。 跨智能体与留出评测显示，各受评智能体的易感性存在显著差异，而检测失败与服从仍是两种不同的结果。 基于 Cialdini 原则的分析催生了一个通用技能，无需进一步的针对特定目标的优化即可暴露多个留出智能体的漏洞，尽管它并未确立相对演化技能的一致优越性。 总之，这些发现表明，除了传统的钓鱼测试之外，还需要自适应的、基于行为的评估。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Our evaluation covers synthetic, single-message social-engineering attacks under fixed generation constraints and selected agent configurations. It scores action selection and drafted replies rather than external execution, so measured compliance does not establish completed real-world harm. Finite evaluation batches and model-version dependence limit generalization, while rule-based outcome scoring and LLM-based realism judgments and persuasion annotations may introduce measurement error. Pooled persuasion associations do not establish independent causal effects; the framing ablations provide evidence on two targets but do not isolate every principle or generalize to all agents. Future work should extend evaluation to multi-turn interactions, richer account and tool environments, broader model configurations, and controlled studies of defenses and persuasion mechanisms.

paragraphs.en: This work studies methods for generating phishing emails that can evade LLM email agents, creating a clear dual-use risk. The same techniques used to evaluate agent susceptibility could be misused to craft more effective phishing attacks. We believe publication is justified because the basic capability is already accessible to anyone who can run a scoring loop against commercial APIs, while the contribution of this paper is a controlled characterization of which agent behaviors and persuasion patterns are associated with failures (§ 5.3 ). This characterization provides defensive value for researchers, model providers, and deployers who need to evaluate and harden email agents before they are used in settings involving private information or user-authorized actions.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨生成能够规避 LLM 邮件智能体的钓鱼邮件的方法，存在明显的双重用途风险。 用于评估智能体易感性的相同技术可能被滥用以构造更有效的钓鱼攻击。 我们认为发表是合理的，因为任何能够对商业 API 运行评分循环的人都已经可以获得这一基本能力，而本文的贡献在于对哪些智能体行为和说服模式与失败相关进行了受控的刻画（§ 5.3）。 这一刻画为需要在涉及私人信息或用户授权操作的场景中使用邮件智能体之前对其进行评估和加固的研究者、模型提供商和部署方提供了防御价值。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark is constructed in a controlled synthetic setting. All generated emails use fictional organizations, people, sender addresses, domains, and accounts, and all credentials, links, or secrets are nonfunctional placeholders enforced by the locked benchmark constraints in § 3.3 . No generated email was sent to a real mailbox, no real organization or individual was impersonated or targeted, and no human participants were recruited, deceived, or exposed to generated emails. These constraints allow AgentPhishing to measure detection failure and compliance without creating real-world phishing victims or handling real private data.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试是在受控的合成环境中构建的。 所有生成的电子邮件均使用虚构的组织、人物、发件人地址、域名和账户，且所有凭据、链接或密钥均为无效的占位符，并由 § 3.3 中锁定的基准测试约束予以强制执行。 没有任何生成的电子邮件被发送到真实邮箱，没有冒充或针对任何真实组织或个人，也没有招募、欺骗任何人类参与者或使其接触生成的电子邮件。 这些约束使智能体（AgentPhishing）能够在不制造现实世界中的钓鱼受害者或处理真实私人数据的情况下，测量检测失败与合规性情况。

paragraphs.en: Our release policy is designed to support reproducibility while limiting direct misuse. We release the evaluation pipeline, evolved skill files, metric definitions, analysis code, and aggregate results, but withhold the raw generated email corpora. Withholding the corpora avoids publishing a ready-made set of phishing emails and reduces the risk of casual reuse. This mitigation is limited: because the released skills are generator prompts, a determined user could regenerate similar examples. We therefore treat withholding as a friction-raising measure rather than a complete safeguard, preserving reproducibility while avoiding the easiest path to direct misuse. We did not pursue coordinated disclosure with individual model providers because the behavior studied here is not a single patchable vulnerability in one deployed system; it arises from interactions among model behavior, agent prompts, task interfaces, and persuasive email content. We treat public characterization as the appropriate disclosure mechanism because it informs model providers, agent developers, and deployers about a risk channel that may not be exposed by static phishing tests or prompt-injection benchmarks alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的发布策略旨在支持可复现性，同时限制直接滥用。 我们发布评估流水线、演化后的技能文件、指标定义、分析代码以及汇总结果，但不公开原始生成的邮件语料。 不公开语料可以避免发布一套现成的钓鱼邮件，并降低被随意复用的风险。 这一缓解措施存在局限：由于发布的技能是生成器提示词，有决意的用户仍可能重新生成类似的示例。 因此，我们将不公开视为一种提高阻力的措施，而非完全的保障，在保持可复现性的同时避免通往直接滥用的最便捷途径。 我们没有与各个模型提供方进行协同披露，因为本文研究的行为并非某个已部署系统中单一的、可修补的漏洞；它源于模型行为、智能体提示词、任务界面与说服性邮件内容之间的交互。 我们将公开描述视为恰当的披露机制，因为它能让模型提供方、智能体开发者与部署者了解这一风险渠道，而仅靠静态钓鱼测试或提示词注入基准可能无法暴露该渠道。

paragraphs.en: One methodological point matters for interpreting Table 7 . Self-BLEU and distinct- n n both scale with sample size, so corpora of unequal size cannot be compared directly. paragraphs.en: * Mean of two independent 20-email batches ( gemini-3.5-flash 0.269/0.225; gpt-5.4 0.565/0.710), run to test whether the gains reproduced. paragraphs.zh: * 两组各20封邮件的独立批次均值（gemini-3.5-flash 为 0.269/0.225；gpt-5.4 为 0.565/0.710），运行该实验以测试增益能否复现。 两个模型的所有批次均高于自身技能分数，因此效应的方向得到了确认，但批次间约 ± 0.05 \pm 0.05 – 0.07 0.07 的波动意味着这一差距应以两组均值的形式引用，而非单点估计值。 其余四个模型均为单次20封邮件的批次。
